nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Access to clean energy for all_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the mission of the Idaho National Laboratory (INL)?
nodes.answer: The mission of INL is to discover, demonstrate, and secure innovative nuclear energy solutions, other clean energy options, and critical infrastructure.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Access to clean energy for all_qna_002
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Why is energy access alone not sufficient for choosing clean cooking fuels?
nodes.answer: Energy access alone does not guarantee the availability or affordability of clean cooking fuels, leading to continued use of traditional and polluting sources.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Access to clean energy for all_qna_003
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How do fossil fuel lobbyists gain access to COP events according to the analysis?
nodes.answer: Fossil fuel lobbyists gain access to COP events through developed-country business NGOs and developing-country governments.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Access to clean energy for all_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How have ECAs contributed to energy systems in recipient countries?
nodes.answer: ECAs have contributed to locking in recipient countries to fossil fuel energy systems, such as coal-fired power stations in Asia and gas infrastructure in Africa.
nodes.subtopic: Access to clean energy for all

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Access to clean energy for all_qna_005
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What actions did European ECAs take regarding fossil fuel energy projects in 2022?
nodes.answer: European ECAs committed to ending export credit for fossil fuel energy projects in 2022.
nodes.subtopic: Access to clean energy for all

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Access to clean energy for all_qna_006
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why have ECAs been considered an important factor in the energy systems of recipient countries?
nodes.answer: ECAs have helped lock-in recipient countries to fossil fuel energy systems, such as coal-fired power stations in Asia and gas infrastructure in Africa.
nodes.subtopic: Access to clean energy for all

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate justice and equity|Access to clean energy for all_qna_007
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What significant action did European ECAs take in 2022 regarding fossil fuel energy projects?
nodes.answer: In 2022, European export credit agencies (ECAs) committed to ending export credit for fossil fuel energy projects.
